mapper.select:
SELECT seq, id, name, comment, TO_CHAR(reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_date FROM member WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
AND id LIKE '%' || #{id} || '%'
AND name LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
ORDER BY reg_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (id, name, comment, reg_date, use_yn) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{comment}, NOW(), 'Y')
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, comment = #{comment}, upd_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
